card.title: TUNIS CITY
card.text: The capture of Tunis City in 1943 saw all of North Africa in Allied hands.
card.flavorText: Tunis City, the capital of Tunisia was one of the Allied objectives in Operation Torch, the Allied landings in North Africa in 1942. The Tunisian Campaign lasted from November 17, 1942 to May 13, 1943 and was a series of battles that took place in French Tunisia between the Axis and the Allies. The Allied coalition consisted of British, Greek, American and French forces versus the German and Italian forces on the Axis side. The campaign ended with an Allied victory and the ejection of the Axis forces from North Africa.
